# file-hasher

> Fast CLI tool for calculating SHA256, SHA1, and MD5 file hashes with progress bars, verification, and streaming support for large files.

file-hasher is maintained by marcuspat (Agentic Engineer — Platform Engineering × AI-assisted development).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://marcuspat.github.io/file-hasher/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/marcuspat/file-hasher): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
cargo install file-hasher
```
